details: CONFIRMED by reading. Claude Code's auto-memory is per project folder: ~/.claude/projects/-Users-amidman-relay/memory/
holds owner-native-language.md; other projects have their own folders. The only text every project reads,
~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, is generated by `relay sync` from rules/ and projects.toml, so a fact a model writes there is lost
at the next sync. projects.toml registers relay, alix, arsenal, testenv, cartoons, clean, kartoteka, mind, sight,
glyph, noisegate and more: "ask me once" becomes once per project. The bullet promises "so you do not ask again"; the
queue item this change closes promises "kept as a user fact". Where to keep it is a small choice for the owner
(question 1 in notes); the fix itself is small either way.
Size: 30 (option a: a field in relay's data + one rendered line + a test of the render), 5 (option b: reword).
evidence: rules/working-with-me.md:34-35 "ask me once, directly, and keep the answer in the project's memory so you do not ask again"
.relay/queue/replies-in-the-owner-s-native-language.json "what": "... Where the native language is known it is kept as a user fact ..."
failing_case: The owner opens a front session in ~/kartoteka (or mind, clean, alix ... 13 projects in projects.toml). Its memory
folder has no owner-native-language entry (only relay's has it). The rule says "If you do not know it, ask me once ...
keep the answer in the project's memory", so the session asks the native language again, and keeps it only for
Kartoteka. Expected (queue item replies-in-the-owner-s-native-language, "what"): the language "is kept as a user fact",
known in every project once the owner has said it.
fix_hint: Option a: keep the value as relay data (e.g. `native_language` under [global] in projects.toml, schema-checked) and have
lib/relay_rules.py render "My native language: <value>." after the bullet in every generated file; the bullet says
"if it is not written here, ask me once and tell the front to record it with relay". Option b: change "the project's
memory" to nothing new and reword the queue item's "what" to per-project.
pass_cases: 1. Native language recorded once (Russian, from the relay session); new session in ~/kartoteka: the front replies in
2. Same record; new session in ~/relay: replies in Russian without asking (works today).
3. No record anywhere: the front asks once, directly; after the answer, a session in another project does not ask.
4. The rule text still says "native language" and does not name Russian (owner: "use native language term").
5. (if the owner picks per-project instead) the queue item's "what" no longer says "kept as a user fact".
reason: tests/test_relay.py:1752 asserts the line appears for global when the key is set, not when absent, not for a project target, and projects.toml holds Russian; test passed. Rule text says "native language", not Russian.
findings.summary: the answer is kept in the project's memory, so every other project asks again; the queue item promised a user fact

details: PLAUSIBLE (a model may well read "tool" as machine-only and do the right thing). The owner asked only about the
language spoken to him ("I don't like speak in English"); the "stay English" list sets a new global rule for every
project, which is broader than the request. A project CLAUDE.md overrides it, but Glonass work has no project file of
evidence: rules/working-with-me.md:36-37 "Code, file names, commit messages, project docs and anything another agent or a tool reads stay English"
~/kartoteka/README.md: "Картотека: a Russian-language web app ... the audience is in Russia"
rules/glonass.md: Tracker issues and comments are written through glonass_* tools
failing_case: In a Glonass project the owner asks the front to post a Tracker comment for colleagues through a glonass_* tool, or a
worker in ~/kartoteka ("a Russian-language web app") writes card descriptions into code. The bullet, loaded globally,
says "Code ... project docs and anything another agent or a tool reads stay English": read literally, the Tracker
comment and the Russian product copy in code should be English. Expected: those keep the language their readers use;
the bullet only governs how the front talks to the owner.
fix_hint: "Everything else keeps the language it already has: code, file names, commit messages, docs and what another agent or
a tool reads stay in the project's language (English unless the project says otherwise)."
pass_cases: 1. Front reply to the owner in relay: in the owner's native language (unchanged).
2. Commit message, file name, hand-back between agents in relay: English (unchanged).
3. Tracker comment for Russian-speaking colleagues, or Kartoteka UI copy: in the language of its readers, not forced English.
reason: rules/working-with-me.md:33-38 now says code, docs, commits and tool/agent text keep the project's language (English unless the project says otherwise).
findings.summary: "stay English" is global and reaches text meant for Russian readers (Glonass Tracker comments, Kartoteka's Russian copy)
